title: Prospectus: one 'papyrus' product whose tenant deployments are created by API and held as data
description:
Outcome: Owner decision A (Ryan, 2026-11-08): launching a new site must be a data change only, with no code edit and no deployment. Today each site is a Prospectus product "papyrus-<site>" with its own reviewed entry in accounts/papyrus-sites.json, its own Cognito user pool, app client and compute role, capped at about 40 entries; there is no self-serve provisioning API and no invite by email (kanbus-59284c, kanbus-4c99c6, kanbus-b09c91, kanbus-db57cb); no lifecycle events yet (kanbus-6efecd). Needed in Prospectus: one product "papyrus" registered once for the shared stack (one pool, one client, one compute role); a deployment record per tenant (deployment id = site id, owning Account UUID, state) created and changed through an authenticated API and stored as data; entitlements per deployment; invites by email for Account members. Papyrus's side: the provisioning workflow (PPY-70a429) calls that API and never edits a file in either repository. Dedicated sites keep their per-site product entries. Coordinate with the Prospectus session; its approval is needed for Prospectus changes.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): Prospectus repository: accounts/papyrus-sites.json (stays for dedicated sites), the accounts plane (infra/lib/accounts-plane.ts), new deployment routes and records; Papyrus: lib/tenant-keys.ts, lib/prospectus-tenant.ts, the provisioning function.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-provisioning.feature (Papyrus side) and a Prospectus feature file named by its session):
Scenario: A new shared-tier site is created with no code change
    Given an Account that has paid for a shared-tier site
    When provisioning asks Prospectus to create deployment "harbour-news" of product "papyrus"
    Then the deployment exists as data, no file in either repository changed, and nothing was deployed

Scenario: The per-site cap does not apply to shared-tier sites
    Given 200 shared-tier deployments
    When one more is created
    Then it succeeds

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-6d9a6d. Blocks PPY-1da916. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-a1e75a, PPY-8bb56d.

Testing: Behave against a fake Prospectus for the Papyrus side; Prospectus's own specs for its side.
Rollout: Prospectus change first, behind its own flag; Papyrus provisioning consumes it once deployed.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: a data-driven product removes the human review that each site entry had today. Mitigation: the provisioning security review (PPY-1da916) with its controls is a gate.

Releasable on its own: yes, in Prospectus (Papyrus side waits).
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: changes: Prospectus product and deployment authorisation.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
